definitions.descriptive: each configuration's 5-seed (score-average) IC 2018-19 and per-seed ICs; variance-reduction curve: IC of the k-seed average for k = 1..5, mean (and range) over all C(5,k) seed subsets, per configuration and for the 4-configuration rank ensemble.
